title: Anjney Midha Launches $4 B300 GPU Nodes for Gov and Edu
summary:
Academic, government, and military researchers can now access hundreds of frontier compute nodes through a new subsidized allocation. The resource pool, launched by Anjney Midha, offers 8x B300 nodes for $4 per GPU hour and AMD MI355X nodes for $3 to users with .edu, .gov, or .mil email addresses. Bookings are managed by an AI agent named Marshall, and wait times for MI355X nodes are currently under one minute.

The initiative targets researchers who have been priced out of the market and seeks to scale the frontier ecosystem for public benefit. This pricing is lower than the $9.50 per GPU hour on demand charge at Nebius, and comes at a time when many other cloud providers are sold out of high end capacity.
